text.text: Run the club from one page. Subscribers, box items, vendors and shipments are linked. Shipments move from New to Delivered, the packer sees their own boxes under Mine, and Box items flags what to reorder before the next cycle.
The makers and packers behind each box, with lead times and terms.

Subscribers with plan, shipments, returns and lifetime value.

Shipments by status, sales by channel and products by category.
Run the same calendar every month so nothing is rushed.

text.text: Watch the Returns list and the pause and cancel requests for two weeks.
Many cancellations are really I have too much. Offer a pause or a smaller box first.
Offer to skip a month before cancelling.
Ask why in one line and record the reason.
Offer a quarterly plan if monthly feels like too much.
Tag cancellations by reason every month.
Fix them fast and send a small gift. A late box is the most common reason for cancelling.
Presentation is the product. Check it like a customer would.
Pack in batches of 50 from a pick list.
One person checks every tenth box against the list.
Photograph a finished box for the record.
Hold any box with a damaged item.
Order accuracy above 99 percent and boxes ready one week before the ship date.
